scope: First deeper-source discovery increment: observed GET forms, bounded Chromium rendering, source evidence and durable reuse.

details: Three controlled demand categories: static result HTML has no listing links; Chromium exposes the observed detail link and the planner follows it.
Real Chromium blocks writes, frames and private destinations; missing resources stay incomplete.
A resource-flood test confirms bounded attempts and cancellation of queued I/O before returning.
PostgreSQL checks preserve form decisions, owner isolation, shared public capture reuse and partial status.
